subject: Tech intake + multi-team deep-dive: VPC / IPsec / IAM — scheduling
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medsys.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-11-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Tech intake + multi-team deep-dive: VPC / IPsec / IAM — scheduling

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the quick discovery call yesterday. Per our conversation, the next step is a multi-stakeholder technical deep-dive so our SE and Security leads can validate the connectivity and IAM model. Goal: make sure the on-prem/VPC networking, IPSec tunnels, and role mappings will work with Redwood Dedicated/Private deployment.

Would you and the Medsys infra/security folks be available for a 90-minute slot the week of Dec 4 or Dec 11? Suggested agenda (we can adjust):
- 0–15m: introductions + success criteria (AE + customer)
- 15–50m: network topology walk (customer leads) — routes, peering, firewall rules, NAT
- 50–80m: IAM & service identity (roles, key management, access controls)
- 80–90m: action items / next steps (SOW / procurement kickoff)

We’d like the following internal attendees: Ben Carter (SE) to cover runtime/networking, Dev Patel to cover security/HSM/KMS integration, and Marissa to join for procurement/SOW discussion. Could you suggest 2–3 available windows (PST preferred)? Also please confirm who from Medsys (infra, security, procurement) should be on the invite so we loop them.

I can circulate a pre-read and a mutual action plan once we lock a time.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medsys.io>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-11-29T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Tech intake + multi-team deep-dive: VPC / IPsec / IAM — scheduling

On Wed, Nov 28, 2028 at 09:12 AM Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Thanks again for the quick discovery call yesterday. Per our conversation, the next step is a multi-stakeholder technical deep-dive...

Thanks Aisha — this sounds good. I’ll be the primary engineer from our side. Attendees I expect to join: Priya Singh (procurement) for the SOW/finance bit, Ravi Kumar (security lead) from our SecOps team (security@medsys.io), and myself for infra.

We prefer late-morning PST. Available windows (all 90m):
- Tues Dec 5, 10:30–12:00 PST
- Thu Dec 7, 11:00–12:30 PST
- Mon Dec 11, 10:00–11:30 PST

I attached an updated network topology (medsys-network-topology.pdf) that covers our datacenter and the edge firewalls — Ben/Dev please review.

Two quick asks for the deep-dive:
1) If you need packet captures or test connectivity, we can provision a temporary bastion host and an account for your SEs.
2) For IAM, we’ll need to confirm whether Redwood will assume roles or use a service principal with scoped keys.

If any of the proposed slots work for you, lock it and send the invite + agenda.

—
Alex Turner
Staff Infrastructure Engineer, Medsys
attach: medsys-network-topology.pdf (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@medsys.io>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.inference>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-11-30T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Tech intake + multi-team deep-dive: VPC / IPsec / IAM — scheduling

Alex —

Thanks for the topology PDF. I reviewed the doc and have a short checklist of items I want to cover in the deep-dive so we can validate compatibility with Redwood Private:
- IPsec tunnel params and rekey windows (MTU considerations)
- NAT traversal / static routes vs. BGP-on-topology
- Public endpoints and whether any traffic will need TLS passthrough at the edge
- KV cache reachability and expected sequence lengths for performance profiling
- IAM model: role assumption vs service principal; KMS/HSM integration points

Two logistical things:
1) If you can provision the bastion account, please include a test user and a short SSH key so our SEs can run tcpdump (we'll only capture traffic to/from the test endpoint). I put together a short how-to (capture-instructions.txt) that we can send ahead of time.
2) Can you share any firewall logs or recent ACLs that might affect NAT behaviour?

Tentatively I can take Thu Dec 7, 11:00–12:30 PST. If you want the Dec 5 window instead, Aisha — I can swap with my afternoon.

- Ben
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attach: capture-instructions.txt (stub)

Procurement will not need to attend the full engineering session. Please include me for the last 10–15 minutes (action items / SOW/PO). For procurement prep, can you share:
- An initial SOW draft or scope of work (even a bullet list is fine)
- Pricing bands or committed GPU capacity tiers
- Any compliance docs (SOC2 / data residency statement) we should include in the contract

I see a DocuSign SOW link in your hubspot; can you circulate that to me once you have the draft?

Also: Dec 7, 11:00–12:30 PST works for Alex and Ravi. We will join the last 15m.

Thanks —
Priya Singh
Procurement Lead, Medsys
